title: The Book Held So Both Could See
youtube_title: The Book Held So Both Could See | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Jorie is just outside the fun, close to a book held in the middle. Ines changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Jorie has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
